# w=wh-word, t=to-marker, e=existential there). Case variants of the same
# lemma+POS (record_N / Record_N / RECORD_N in the raw source) ARE summed

# lowercases everywhere else, not a cross-POS merge.

# abbreviations, speaker-tag artifacts) with no reliable part-of-speech

# tokens (which can never match a real profiled word token anyway) and
# multi-word transcript annotations (e.g. "dog_barking", "there_you_go" --
# closed-caption stage directions, not real lemmas). Spelled-out cardinal
# numbers (one, million, ...) are also dropped specifically from the "c"
# (conjunction) tag -- a quirk of the source data tags them that way, but
# real text tags them as a cardinal number, which isn't in our POS map,
